purpose: Automatically generates and keeps README.md files up to date for other teams' software repositories by scanning source code for entry points, dependencies, config and CI setup, so engineering teams no longer let docs drift out of sync with the codebase.
business_overview: Helps engineering teams stop letting README files go stale by generating them from the actual codebase instead of relying on someone remembering to update docs by hand.
target_users: New hires onboarding onto a repo
key_capabilities: Connect a GitHub repository via a read-only integration
Generate a README.md from the scanned codebase
Propose a diff when the repo changes materially
lifecycle_status: Private beta with a handful of design-partner teams

go_live_date.reason: ReadmeForge is being rolled out gradually to design-partner teams as a continuous beta; there is no single formal go-live date to record yet.
